title: Betfin Template
subtitle: A standalone Module Federation remote. Run it on its own, or plug it into any host by adding one entry to the whitelabel manifest — no host rebuild.

wallet.title: Wallet & host state
wallet.desc: How a remote reads the host's wallet.
wallet.body: A host mounts its wallet provider inside its own web3 package, not on the bare shared wagmi singleton — so an independent remote can't read it with useAccount(). Consume the host's shared web3 package (in-monorepo remotes) or a public wallet bridge the host exposes. See the README.

integrate.title: Integrate via manifest
integrate.desc: Add these entries to the host's whitelabel manifest to mount this app.
